Please solve this issue: When a customer cancels mid-period we refund the unused part of the current period. Add `prorated_refund(sub, cancel_at)` to `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: the plan price multiplied by the unused fraction of the billing period that contains `cancel_at` (unused time divided by the period length), rounded to the cent.

## Notes from earlier work
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-c0037] Prorated refund detail: The prorated refund feature flag is read from settings.FEATURES at import time.
  (learned from task T4037 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only approved_by=None and raise BillingError("approval_required") when the amount exceeds the threshold and approved_by is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-c0026] Prorated refund detail: Keep prorated refund functions short; move parsing into a private _parse helper in the same module.

- [at-c0058] Prorated refund detail: Support asked for prorated refund reasons as free text of at most 200 characters.

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Subscription
from .money import round_money, to_money


def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length


def prorated_refund(sub: Subscription, cancel_at: datetime):
    """Refund for the unused part of the current period."""
    cancel_at = ensure_utc(cancel_at)
    period_start, period_end = current_period(sub, cancel_at)
    period_length = period_end - period_start
    unused = period_end - cancel_at
    unused_seconds = Decimal(str(unused.total_seconds()))
    period_seconds = Decimal(str(period_length.total_seconds()))
    return round_money(to_money(sub.plan_price) * unused_seconds / period_seconds)
"
}

def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length


def prorated_refund(sub: Subscription, cancel_at: datetime):
    """Refund for the unused part of the current period."""
    cancel_at = ensure_utc(cancel_at)
    period_start, period_end = current_period(sub, cancel_at)
    period_length = period_end - period_start
    unused = period_end - cancel_at
    unused_seconds = Decimal(str(unused.total_seconds()))
    period_seconds = Decimal(str(period_length.total_seconds()))
    return round_money(to_money(sub.plan_price) * unused_seconds / period_seconds)
